source: Phase 14.3A shared_trinity_architecture.json + per-app canons + OS Platform Standard v1

shared_repo_strategy.github_reality: Separate repos confirmed — antonyfmunoz/EntrepreneurOS, antonyfmunoz/CreatorOS, antonyfmunoz/LYFEOS
shared_repo_strategy.notes: Standard and reality match. Monorepo never adopted.

shared_auth_target.notes: No app uses Clerk yet. Firebase recommendation in OS Platform Standard v1 is STALE. Each app has different legacy auth. Migration to Clerk is a Work Packet for all three.
stale_items: Firebase auth recommendation in OS Platform Standard v1

shared_database_assumptions.notes: Separate DBs per app matches standard. ORM choice (Drizzle) is consistent for EOS, needs verification for others.

shared_deployment_assumptions.notes: Separate deployments match standard. But deployment targets are fragmented — Replit for EOS, unknown for others. No unified deployment strategy.

shared_ui_design_system_opportunities.os_platform_standard_v1: Shared glassmorphic + light/dark UI design system
shared_ui_design_system_opportunities.lyfeos: Dark futuristic UI (specific hex codes in PRD)
shared_ui_design_system_opportunities.notes: EOS uses shadcn/ui (standard React component library). LyfeOS has custom dark theme with specific colors. No shared design system exists. Glassmorphic recommendation partially aligns with LyfeOS dark aesthetic but not with EOS shadcn defaults.

shared_api_conventions.os_platform_standard_v1: Shared response envelope, cursor pagination, Zod validation
shared_api_conventions.reality: Each app likely has independent API patterns
shared_api_conventions.notes: Needs code inspection to verify if any app follows the standard conventions. Standard defines patterns but adoption is unverified.

shared_analytics_event_taxonomy_opportun.opportunity: Define shared event taxonomy before any app implements PostHog
shared_analytics_event_taxonomy_opportun.notes: Clean slate opportunity — no legacy analytics to migrate.

os_platform_standard_v1_kits: Kit 1: Auth + Session (Firebase recommended — STALE, target is Clerk)
Kit 2: UI Component Library (GlassCard, DataTable, etc.)
Kit 3: API Layer (response envelope, pagination, validation)
shared_portable_kit_opportunities.os_core_kit_transfer_plan: AI Tools Tab 3 — 44,993 chars implementation checklist
shared_portable_kit_opportunities.current_adoption: Kit 5 (folder conventions) appears partially adopted in EOS (/client, /server, /shared structure)
shared_portable_kit_opportunities.notes: Kits defined but not extracted as reusable packages. Each app implements patterns independently. Kit extraction is a future Work Packet.

duplicate_cross_platform_tabs_docs.finding: Cross-platform operating architecture tab content appears in all three product docs (EOS Tab 10, CreatorOS Tab 8, LyfeOS Tab 52)
duplicate_cross_platform_tabs_docs.recommendation: Extract shared architecture content once, reference from each canon

os_platform_standard_v1_stale_items: Firebase token auth recommendation — Clerk is target
Glassmorphic UI assumption may not match all apps
Kit 1 (Auth) assumes Firebase — needs complete rewrite for Clerk
what_should_become_os_platform_standard_: Clerk auth as standard across all apps
PostHog analytics as standard across all apps
Neon Postgres + Drizzle ORM as standard across all apps
shadcn/ui + Tailwind as shared component baseline
Shared API response envelope + Zod validation
Updated portable kit definitions reflecting Clerk and current stack
Deployment target standardization (Fly.io, Vercel, or specific provider)

premature_shared_packages_warning: Do not force premature shared package extraction. Each app must prove its patterns work independently before extracting reusable kits.
monolith_warning: Do not collapse apps into one monolith. Separate repos, separate deployments, separate DBs.
evidence_based_extraction: Only extract shared kits when 2+ apps implement the same pattern independently and extraction would reduce maintenance burden.
